title: Ordered coordinate characters of a split torus
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $\mathbf G_{m,k}$ be the multiplicative $k$-group scheme [def-sc-gm-ga], in the category of $k$-group schemes [def-sc-group-scheme]. For $r\in\mathbf N$, let $T_r=\mathbf G_{m,k}^{r}$ be the ordered split torus [def-sfb-tori-multiplicative-type], with $T_0=1$ and $T_{r+1}=\mathbf G_{m,k}\times T_r$. The ordered coordinate characters are the projections $\pi_{r,j}:T_r\to\mathbf G_{m,k}$ for $j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$. Explicitly, the family for $r=0$ is empty, $\pi_{r+1,0}=\operatorname{pr}_1$, and $\pi_{r+1,j+1}=\pi_{r,j}\circ\operatorname{pr}_2$. On points over each commutative $k$-algebra $R$, the character $\pi_{r,j}$ sends $(t_0,\ldots,t_{r-1})$ to $t_j$.
